sources.title: Coze Studio official repository
sources.supported_claim: Visual agent/workflow platform; requires model configuration and separate plugin keys; PAT authentication; README warns of public-network security risks and commercial feature differences.
sources.limits: main is mutable; model-management UI requires image >=0.5.0, not a claim of latest release.

sources.title: Coze Studio LICENSE-APACHE
sources.supported_claim: Apache-2.0 license file exists and repository explicitly identifies that license.

sources.supported_claim: Enterprise work partner supports app/user identities; personal resource authorization cards; channel configuration and publishing differ.
sources.limits: Navigation now uses 豆包工作伙伴 while article names aily 企业工作伙伴; exact migration date unknown.

sources.title: aily 智能伙伴可用范围
sources.supported_claim: Enterprise administrators control available user/department ranges.

sources.title: 创建 AI 助理 — 宜搭
sources.supported_claim: Named 宜搭 AI 助理; non-admin creation application; within-organization restriction; data analysis/form filling; initial scope choice; knowledge refresh requires republishing.

sources.supported_claim: Delegated scopes and OAuth user approval; denying approval prevents obtaining authorization code.

sources.title: Zia Agents Roles & Permissions
sources.supported_claim: Four predefined roles; Collaborator cannot deploy, admins can; role customization unavailable.
sources.limits: Prose and matrix are not perfectly aligned on viewer/query and role creation; avoid stronger interpretation.

sources.title: Zia Agents Settings
sources.supported_claim: Organization/team controls, integrations, credits and BYOK settings; admin setup required.

sources.title: 阿里云百炼 Agent Studio FAQ
sources.supported_claim: Visual Agent differs from Assistant API; knowledge/plugin/MCP support; application tests can incur charges.

sources.title: 百炼权限管理
sources.supported_claim: Workspace model/user permissions; RAM/OpenAPI permissions separate; workspace cannot span geographic regions.

sources.title: Model Studio application introduction (international)
sources.supported_claim: Page updated 2026-10-11: Singapore pre-2025-04-21 application customers restriction; Agent 1.0/workflow preview warning.
